identifier_policy.allowed: stable pseudonyms local to one fixture set
identifier_policy.forbidden: raw client, environment, account, workspace, session, stream, thread or turn identifiers

time_policy: relative milliseconds from capture start unless wall clock is required for expiry validation
content_policy: method names and structural field names only; user and assistant content must be removed
gate_rule: The contract alone is preparation. Gate P0 evidence exists only after a real fixture set passes validation and its external/manual observations remain self-attested unless independently replayed.

history_probe.fixture_kind: G0 lazy-history evidence captured by probe/history_probe.mjs (schema_version 2)
history_probe.pseudonym_policy: id-N for id-shaped strings, cur-N for opaque cursors; mapping stable within one capture and never reversible from the fixture
history_probe.content_policy: item text, paths and error bodies appear only as lengths; enum values survive only for whitelisted keys (type/status/itemsView/historyMode/sortDirection/sortKey/code and similar)
history_probe.negative_result_rule: any §3.0.7 negative in the harness report means G0 FAIL, not evidence captured; adjudication of T0.5/T0.6/G0.5 and resource gate values stays with the owner
